--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1A8N1QQYFF6376DMXMT6FMC
+- 01M1A8NKPNMZJCCMJFHDDAXWAZ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: Wire the integration suite into CI and invert the workflow tests that forbid it
+---
+## What
+
+Point CI at the nested package, and fix the tests that currently assert the opposite.
+
+Files to change:
+- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — add a `with:` block passing `integration-package-path: IntegrationTests` to the shared `swift-ci.yaml` call. The file currently has a bare `uses:` with no inputs at all. Also rewrite its header comment, which states this repository has no integration suite.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsMetadataRegistryTests/CIWorkflowTests.swift` — **this is the trap.** `passesNoIntegrationInput()` asserts that `ci.yml` contains no line beginning `integration-`. That test will fail the moment the input is added, and it is correct to fail: it was written when the suite was deleted. Replace it with a test asserting `integration-package-path: IntegrationTests` IS present. Keep `callsTheSharedWorkflow()` and `declaresNoRepoLocalJobs()`. Rewrite the suite doc comment, which says the integration job must stay switched off.
+
+Do not pass `integration-gate-env` — that input is LEGACY, and this repository's own ci.yml comment is what pointed the FoundationModelsRanker session at the correct mechanism. Do not pass `integration-metallib-glob`: that existed for MLX's Metal library, and there is no MLX in this graph any more.
+
+### Evidence this works
+
+FoundationModelsRanker migrated to `integration-package-path: IntegrationTests` in `a2a9718` and verified it on run 33318330212 — both jobs green, integration no longer skipped, 4 real-model tests running on the runner at 3.8-6.8s each. The org's runners are self-hosted macOS 27 machines with Apple Intelligence enabled, which is why the loud-failure choice in `^jzba4xn` is safe.
+
+### Check for other guards before you finish
+
+Grep the whole test suite for assertions about the absence of an integration suite. `PackageManifestTests.swift` and `PlanDocumentTests.swift` were both written during the removal and may carry similar claims. `plan.md` decision #14 states "the repository has no integration suite at all" and that `ci.yml` calls the shared workflow "with no inputs" — both become false. `PlanDocumentTests` asserts that any `plan.md` section naming `IntegrationTests` also cites `decision #14`, so a new dated note is the shape to add, not a rewrite.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` passes `integration-package-path: IntegrationTests` and no other `integration-*` input.
+- [ ] `CIWorkflowTests` asserts the input is present, and no test anywhere asserts its absence.
+- [ ] No test or document still claims this repository has no integration suite.
+- [ ] `plan.md` records the reinstatement with a dated note that cites decision #14, so `PlanDocumentTests` stays green.
+- [ ] CI runs both jobs on the next push, and the integration job is not `skipped`.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Run `swift test` at the root. All tests pass, including the rewritten `CIWorkflowTests` and `PlanDocumentTests`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests`. Both real-model tests pass.
+- [ ] After pushing, read the run for the new HEAD with `gh run view <id> --json jobs`. Assert the `Integration` job reports `success`, not `skipped`, and that its `Run the selected integration tests` step ran.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
